rationale: The browser capture records the computed -webkit-font-smoothing (one more COMPUTED_STYLES name), the lowering marks antialiased text nodes with a font_smoothing attribute (absent reads as auto, so existing captures and IR are unchanged), the native materializer sets it on the Label, design_ir_text_raster_policy() picks the chromium text raster policy for a document holding antialiased text, and the design-IR observer creates its raster and GPU surfaces with it through the existing #10942 surface configuration. Adds a committed capture fixture and a design-ir-observe fixture with their checks. No capture schema, IR schema, Chromium, packaging or framework authority moves; the canvas-kernel hunk is covered by its own change event.
